final: SELECT store_id, AVG(total) AS avg_total, AVG(cnt) AS avg_payments FROM (SELECT p.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.amount >= 4.99 GROUP BY p.rental_id, i.store_id) GROUP BY store_id
